message.content:
Flannel shirt dress, relaxed fit with a slightly dropped shoulder and midi length falling below the knee, color #c4a490 made of soft cotton flannel.
Leather ankle boots, square toe and low block heel for stability on grass, color #6b4f3d in full-grain leather.
Gold hoop earrings, small gauge for a delicate touch, color #ffd700 in polished gold vermeil.
This outfit works because the flannel dress strikes the perfect balance between casual comfort required for a park setting and the refined look of a neat occasion. The earthy autumn tones complement her warm skin tone while providing enough coverage to feel cozy during daytime daylight. The leather boots add a structured element that elevates the relaxed silhouette without compromising the ease needed for walking outdoors.
